source:
Study(
    title="MA Crossover (Golden Cross) Strategy",
)

Subjects(
    s1=Strategy("keel/ma_crossover_crypto@1"),
)

Run(
    days=Days("2025-11-18", "2026-11-18"),
    split=Split("2026-07-20"),
    coins=Coins(["BTC", "ETH", "SOL", "BNB", "XRP", "DOGE", "HYPE", "SUI"], chosen=SubjectUniverse("s1")),
    costs=Costs(fee=0.00045, slippage=0.00045),
    data=Data("snap_d96e8eccc0bce098"),
)

Steps(
    map=SettingsGrid(axes=[SettingAxis("step[1].branch[fast].step[0].window", [5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30], name="fast", stamp=Stamp("EWMA", version=1, param="window", value=20, written=True)), SettingAxis("step[1].branch[slow].step[0].window", [40, 60, 80, 100, 150, 200], name="slow", stamp=Stamp("EWMA", version=1, param="window", value=50, written=True))]),
    split=SplitCompare(grid="map"),
)

Views(
    Page(default="Fast × slow", switch=["Fast × slow", "Before vs after the split", "Every setting"]),
    Heatmap("Fast × slow", of="map", x=Axis("slow"), y=Axis("fast"), colour=Raw(Control("measure", "sharpe", options=["sharpe", "cagr", "max_drawdown"])), marks=[Ring(Yours()), Box(Selected())], select="cell"),
    Scatter("Before vs after the split", of="split", x=Raw("sharpe_before"), y=Raw("sharpe_after")),
    Distribution("Every setting", of="map", x=Raw("sharpe"), marker=Final("map", measure="sharpe", at={"fast": 20, "slow": 50})),
    Curve("Across fast", of="map", x=Axis("fast"), y=Raw("sharpe"), where=Is("slow", Selected("slow"))),
    Curve("Across slow", of="map", x=Axis("slow"), y=Raw("sharpe"), where=Is("fast", Selected("fast"))),
)
